citation: Young (2013) could not rule out early collapse
claims: - **Pluto solution families.** Young (2013) finds three: permanent northern volatiles with high thermal inertia, hemispheric exchange with a pressure plateau, and exchange with early atmospheric collapse.
- **Atmospheric collapse.** Young (2013) could not rule out early collapse; Bertrand et al. (2018) find the pressure never drops below milli-pascals.
